title: ATLAS: adaptive-learning speculator system
gist: A speculative decoding setup that learns at runtime: a fixed draft model gives a floor, a lightweight one learns from live traffic, and a controller chooses between them and sets how far to look ahead.
changes: The origin of the learn-from-live-traffic line in production serving, a year before the agent announcements. Its predecessor post gives one of the few like-for-like figures for customer-specific tuning.
caveats: Batch size 1 on narrow traffic is the best case. Does not say whether learning is isolated per customer. No outside check.

bears_on.note: Like for like, customer-specific tuning was worth 23 to 45% here.
A draft model goes stale as traffic drifts; this was built to fix that.
